stem:
Meera drops four objects on the kitchen floor and listens to the sound each one makes.

| object | P | Q | R | S |
| sound heard | ringing | dull | dull | ringing |

Which objects are sonorous?

teacher.key_rationale: Sonority is the property of producing a ringing sound when struck or dropped. P (ringing) and S (ringing) are sonorous; Q and R give dull sounds and are not. Option A pairs one ringing object with a dull one, matching the student who drops the ringing-sound condition. Key: B.
